mapper.select: SELECT id, iccd, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, usage_status, card_status, operator_type, remark, create_time, update_time FROM phone_card ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, iccd, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, usage_status, card_status, operator_type, remark, create_time, update_time FROM phone_card WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO phone_card (iccd, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, usage_status, card_status, operator_type, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{iccd}, #{agentName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{realnameId}, #{realnameName}, #{usageStatus}, #{cardStatus}, #{operatorType}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phone_card
AND usage_status = #{usageStatus}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phone_card
AND card_status = #{cardStatus}
SELECT agent_name AS agentName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM phone_card WHERE agent_name IS NOT NULL AND agent_name != '' GROUP BY agent_name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT card_status AS cardStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM phone_card GROUP BY card_status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m') AS monthLabel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM phone_card WHERE update_time IS NOT NULL AND card_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY monthLabel ASC LIMIT 12

SELECT pc.operator_type AS operatorType, COALESCE(d.dict_value, '其他') AS operatorLabel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM phone_card pc LEFT JOIN sys_dict d ON d.dict_type = 'phone_operator' AND d.dict_key = CAST(pc.operator_type AS CHAR) WHERE pc.realname_id IS NOT NULL OR (pc.realname_name IS NOT NULL AND pc.realname_name != '' AND pc.realname_name != '未实名') GROUP BY pc.operator_type, d.dict_value ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT realname_name AS realnameName, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN operator_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobileCount, SUM(CASE WHEN operator_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unicomCount, SUM(CASE WHEN operator_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS telecomCount, SUM(CASE WHEN operator_type = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS otherCount FROM phone_card WHERE realname_id IS NOT NULL OR (realname_name IS NOT NULL AND realname_name != '' AND realname_name != '未实名') GROUP BY realname_name ORDER BY totalCount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phone_card WHERE realname_id IS NOT NULL OR (realname_name IS NOT NULL AND realname_name != '' AND realname_name != '未实名')
